_note: PRECEDENCE CHANGED 2026-08-06 (founder): behaviour -> code contract,
everything VISUAL -> the Figma board. Text on screen is visual, so the BOARD
is the contract for copy and shell-wireframes.md §5.7 is now ADVISORY.
extract.mjs now captures board copy into specs/<s>.json `copy[]` (entities
decoded). That is the contract side. The COMPARISON is not built, because a
naive string check was measured and fails in four ways:
1. Board text mixes product copy with SAMPLE DATA. topbar carries
'Bella Cucina' (a site name) and 'In review · 3 open' (a live count).
Conforming to those would demand the product say 'Bella Cucina'.
2. Templated copy never matches literally. The board renders
"Nothing matches 'hero'."; the code is `Nothing matches "{query}"`.
3. FALSE POSITIVE measured: that same string 'shipped' only because it
appears in a CODE COMMENT at LayersStateBlocks.tsx:73 quoting the board.
4. FALSE NEGATIVE measured: "Couldn't load the layer tree." read as
missing but ships at LayersStateBlocks.tsx:57 as `Couldn’t` — an
HTML entity. Decoding must happen on BOTH sides.
Until those four are handled, this file guards only the §5.7 lines already
verified present, and ratchets the rest. A copy gate built on the naive check
would be the lying gate this harness exists to prevent.
status: ships   = present in src/, guarded against regression
missing = advisory under the new precedence; resolve by reading the
BOARD, not §5.7.

lines.copy: Collections turn a spreadsheet into pages — one page per row, updated when the data changes.

lines.shipsInstead: ships "No pages yet" + "Add your first page to get started. Pages are the screens visitors see." — and note those describe the ZERO-page state; the spec line describes the ONE-page state, which has no empty state at all.

lines.copy: This page is empty. Drop something on the canvas to see it here.
No brand set. Start from a theme or import your client's tokens.
lines.note: Walked the surface 2026-08-20: Brand > Starters always lists the six built-in starters with the warning 'Applying a starter overwrites your tokens', so the empty state this line describes cannot occur. A site never has zero starters to choose from.

lines.copy: Select something on the canvas to edit it.
This page is ready to publish.
lines.note: Board 164:35 draws the verdict and its consequence as TWO lines, and the panel ships them that way: a green "No issues." with "This page is ready to publish." under it. Recorded as the second line because the checker greps one literal; the pair together is the §5.7 sentence. The old shipsInstead note ("Your site is clean — nothing to fix.") described copy that is no longer there.

lines.copy: No comments yet. Turn on comment mode to leave one.
lines.note: Walked 2026-08-20: comments are canvas PINS, not a list. The topbar toggle turns comment mode on and a canvas click opens a composer labelled 'New comment' with the placeholder 'Leave a comment...'. There is no comments-list surface for this empty state; ReviewTab shows a round's comments once a review exists.

lines.copy: No saved versions yet. Versions are created every time you publish, or whenever you name one.
lines.note: Do NOT implement as written. 'Versions are created every time you publish' is false in the code: auto-checkpoints fire on project:loaded and template:applied only (DEFAULT_VERSION config autoCheckpointEvents), publish creates a PublishBuildJob and no NamedVersion, and nothing else calls createVersion. The panel ships 'No saved versions yet' with the true hint ('Save Version creates a named milestone you can restore anytime'). Either the spec line changes or publish starts snapshotting - a founder call, recorded 2026-08-20.

lines.copy: Start with a template, or drop your first section.
